recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to light gray (#f0f0f0).
2. Add title text 'Neural Network Model' in large bold sans-serif, color dark red (#c00000), positioned top-center spanning ~80% width.
3. Add subtitle text '(Weights of Output Layer AFFECTS Calculated Error)' in medium blue (#0000ff) directly below the title, with 'AFFECTS' in all caps.
4. Place a yellow (#ffff00) circle in the top-right corner containing the white number '7'.
5. Add a magenta (#ff00ff) rectangular box labeled 'Input Sample' at the top-left.
6. Draw 4 purple (#800080) circular input nodes along the left edge.
7. Add a purple (#800080) circle containing '1' at the bottom-left of the input area, with the black text label 'Node Bias' beside it.
8. Draw three vertical columns of 3 blue (#0000ff) circular Sigma nodes each (containing the integral/summation symbol) in the center of the slide.
9. After the final Sigma column, add yellow (#ffff00) circular nodes labeled 'Net' and green (#90ee90) circular nodes labeled 'O_i' and 'O_j'.
10. Label the connections between nodes with blue (#0000ff) text 'w_ji'.
11. Add black (#000000) text labels 'Output 1', 'Output 2', and 'Output m' to the right of the network outputs.
12. Draw a tall vertical red (#ff0000) rectangle on the right side containing the white (#ffffff) word 'Error' repeated 3 times vertically.
13. Add a pink (#ffc0cb) rectangular box labeled 'Target Label' at the top-right, with a dashed arrow from the network outputs to this box.
14. Add black (#000000) text labels 'Class 1', 'Class 2', and 'Class m' on the far right below the Target Label box.
15. Add a white (#ffffff) rectangular box at the bottom-left labeled 'For Layer "j"' containing the black equations 'Net_j = Σ_i (w_ji O_i)' and 'O_j = f(Net_j) = 1/(1+e^-Net_j)'.
16. Add a white (#ffffff) rectangular box in the bottom strip (second from left) labeled 'Previous Layer Layer (i)' with a small black 'i' label.
17. Add a green (#90ee90) rectangular box in the bottom strip (third from left) labeled 'Current Layer is Output Layer (You are here)' with a small black 'j' label.
18. Add a white (#ffffff) rectangular box at the bottom-right labeled 'If Layer "j" is Output Layer:' containing the black equation 'E = 1/2 Σ_j (t_j - O_j)^2'.
